diagnosis: Extranodal marginal zone lymphoma of mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue (MALT lymphoma)

diagnosis: Extranodal marginal zone lymphoma of mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue (MALT lymphoma)

diagnosis: Extranodal marginal zone lymphoma of mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue (MALT lymphoma)

diagnosis: Extranodal marginal zone lymphoma of mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue (MALT lymphoma)

diagnosis: Pulmonary extranodal marginal zone lymphoma of mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue (MALT lymphoma)
legend: The lung shows a diffuse and dense infiltrate of small lymphoid cells, which also infiltrate the bronchial and bronchiolar epithelium to form lymphoepithelial lesions.

diagnosis: Pulmonary extranodal marginal zone lymphoma of mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue (MALT lymphoma)
legend: The lymphoid cells are centrocyte-like or monocytoid B cell–like. They show prominent infiltration of the bronchiolar epithelium.

diagnosis: Extranodal marginal zone lymphoma of mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue (MALT lymphoma) of the lung
legend: CT shows an irregularly shaped nodule with marginal ground-glass opacity (arrow).
